note: Draft Section 10: "That is, BFD hold-down procedures MUST NOT prevent BGP from establishing a connection with the remote BGP speaker." The preceding sentence requires the FSM enabled, while the following paragraph permits Established to wait for hold-down. TestDraftBFDHoldDownDoesNotGateConnectionOrOPEN configures 400 ms, reads the actual local OPEN from an accepted connection, processes the remote OPEN/KEEPALIVE with an unadvanced FakeClock, and distinguishes Down pending from Up running hold-down. session_bfd_strict_test.go TestSessionBFDStrictWithholdsKeepalive and TestSessionBFDStrictEstablishesWhenPeerDoesNotAdvertise confine the gate to negotiated strict mode. Producers advanceAfterOpen and bfdStrictHolds gate KEEPALIVE/establishment, not the already observed TCP/OPEN exchange. Delaying connection/OPEN until hold-down elapsed or bypassing the hold-down assertion fails. This closes the old zero-hold-down fixture gap without demanding Established prematurely. Independent source rejudgment only; no test, mutation, build or gate was executed by this auditor. Native observed-red renewal is a separate parent step.
